summary: Shows that backdooring the random number generator used by randomised smoothing can make certification over- or underestimate robustness by up to 81 times, with tiny changes that NIST randomness tests miss, and argues for updated NIST guidelines for machine learning.

title: PatchCURE: Improving Certifiable Robustness, Model Utility, and Computation Efficiency of Adversarial Patch Defenses
summary: PatchCURE is a tunable framework of certified defenses against adversarial patches that trades off certifiable robustness, utility and computation; at efficiency close to undefended models it gains 16-23% absolute clean and certified robust accuracy over prior defenses.

title: Adaptive Hierarchical Certification for Segmentation using Randomized Smoothing
summary: Certifies semantic segmentation with randomized smoothing over a class hierarchy, relaxing unstable pixels to coarser classes instead of abstaining, and introduces the Certified Information Gain metric; on Cityscapes, PASCAL-Context, ACDC and COCO-Stuff it lowers abstain rate and raises CIG.

title: Breaking the Barrier: Enhanced Utility and Robustness in Smoothed DRL Agents
summary: S-DQN and S-PPO train randomized-smoothing DRL agents with better clean reward, empirical robustness and robustness guarantees, beating existing smoothed agents by 2.16x and robustly trained agents by 2.13x on average under the strongest attack; a stronger Smoothed Attack is also introduced.

title: C-RAG: Certified Generation Risks for Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: C-RAG certifies generation risks of retrieval-augmented language models through conformal risk analysis, giving an upper confidence bound that also holds under distribution shift, and proves RAG attains lower conformal generation risk than a single LLM given non-trivial retrieval quality.

title: Certifiably Byzantine-Robust Federated Conformal Prediction
summary: Rob-FCP makes federated conformal prediction robust to Byzantine clients reporting arbitrary statistics, with a proven coverage bound asymptotically near the target and an estimator for an unknown number of malicious clients, evaluated on five benchmark and healthcare datasets.

title: Collective Certified Robustness against Graph Injection Attacks
summary: Certifies a set of target nodes in graph neural networks at once against graph injection attacks by formulating a binary integer quadratic constrained program and relaxing it to a linear program; on Citeseer the certified ratio rises from 0.0% to 81.2%.

title: Compositional Curvature Bounds for Deep Neural Networks
summary: Bounds the second derivative of continuously differentiable deep networks layer by layer, using the curvature bound with local gradients to give robustness and attack certificates and as a differentiable training regularizer; evaluated on MNIST and CIFAR-10 classification.

title: Effects of Exponential Gaussian Distribution on (Double Sampling) Randomized Smoothing
summary: Studies Exponential Standard Gaussian and Exponential General Gaussian smoothing distributions for randomized smoothing and Double Sampling Randomized Smoothing, deriving certified radius formulas and tighter l2 lower bounds; EGG raises DSRS certified accuracy by up to 6.4% on ImageNet.

title: Efficient Error Certification for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: ∂-CROWN certifies the worst-case residual error of physics-informed neural networks over their whole continuous domain after training, giving tight certificates for PINNs solving Burgers', Schrödinger's, Allan-Cahn and Diffusion-Sorption equations.

title: FairProof : Confidential and Certifiable Fairness for Neural Networks
summary: FairProof publicly verifies the fairness of a confidential fully-connected neural network with zero-knowledge proofs, using a fairness certification algorithm designed to suit such proofs; it is implemented in Gnark and shown to be practically feasible.

title: Fine-grained Local Sensitivity Analysis of Standard Dot-Product Self-Attention
summary: LoFAST analyzes the local sensitivity of dot-product self-attention to l2 input perturbations, showing it is controlled by the attention weight matrices and the unperturbed input, and yields non-vacuous certified l2 robustness for vision transformers on CIFAR-10 and SVHN.

title: Local vs. Global Interpretability: A Computational Complexity Perspective
summary: Uses computational complexity to compare local and global explanations for linear models, decision trees and neural networks, proving that finding global sufficient subsets is harder than local ones for linear models, while the reverse holds for neural networks and decision trees.

title: Lyapunov-stable Neural Control for State and Output Feedback: A Novel Formulation
summary: Learns neural network controllers and observers with Lyapunov certificates over a larger verifiable region of attraction, using fast falsification in training and post-hoc branch-and-bound with linear bound propagation instead of SOS, MIP or SMT solvers; gives formally stable output feedback control.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Policy Iteration: Algorithms, Convergence, and Verification
summary: Proposes extreme learning machine and physics-informed neural network variants of policy iteration for nonlinear optimal control with convergence guarantees, outperforming Galerkin methods, and applies formal verification to show the resulting controllers are stable.

title: Relational DNN Verification With Cross Executional Bound Refinement
summary: RACoon verifies relational properties of DNNs, such as robustness to universal adversarial perturbations and worst-case hamming distance, by exploiting cross-execution dependencies at every layer, gaining substantial precision over existing baselines across datasets, networks and properties.

title: Robust Yet Efficient Conformal Prediction Sets
summary: Makes conformal prediction sets provably robust to evasion and calibration poisoning by bounding the worst-case change in conformity scores; tighter bounds give smaller sets, covering continuous and sparse discrete data and attacks on both features and labels.

title: Verifying message-passing neural networks via topology-based bounds tightening
summary: Certifies robustness of ReLU message-passing neural networks with mixed-integer optimization, handling edge addition and removal, global and local budgets and feature changes, and tightening bounds using graph topology; implemented as an extension of the SCIP branch-and-cut solver.

title: VNN: Verification-Friendly Neural Networks with Hard Robustness Guarantees
summary: Generates verification-friendly neural networks with a post-training optimization that keeps prediction performance close to the original DNN while making the network easier for formal verifiers, so robustness can be established for more networks in less time.

title: CrossCert: A Cross-Checking Detection Approach to Patch Robustness Certification for Deep Learning Models
summary: CrossCert cross-checks two certified recovery defenders against adversarial patches to give unwavering certification, guaranteeing a benign label without warnings under patching, with detection certification comparable to PatchCensor and slightly below ViP.

title: Harnessing Neuron Stability to Improve DNN Verification
summary: VeriStable extends DPLL-based DNN verification by detecting neurons that become stable during search, cutting combinatorial cost, and adds multi-threading and restarts from SAT solvers; on MNIST and CIFAR FNNs, CNNs and ResNets it outperforms α-β-CROWN and MN-BaB.

title: Boosting Few-Pixel Robustness Verification via Covering Verification Designs
summary: Speeds up L0 few-pixel robustness verification with covering verification designs, choosing among candidate coverings by predicting their block size distribution in closed form and building them on the fly in parallel; verification time drops by up to 5.1x on average.

title: Certified Robust Accuracy of Neural Networks Are Bounded Due to Bayes Errors
summary: Derives an upper bound on certified robust accuracy from Bayes error under data distribution uncertainty, explaining why certified training lowers accuracy; for CIFAR10 the bound is 67.49%, while existing methods reached 62.84% by 2023.

title: Marabou 2.0: A Versatile Formal Analyzer of Neural Networks
summary: System description of version 2.0 of Marabou, a framework for formal analysis of neural networks, covering its architectural design and the main features and components added since the first release.

title: Safe Exploration in Reinforcement Learning by Reachability Analysis over Learned Models
summary: VELM keeps reinforcement learning exploration safe by learning symbolic environment models, running formal reachability analysis on them, and shielding the agent to states verified safe; it cuts safety violations compared with other safe learning methods without lowering reward.

title: Unifying Qualitative and Quantitative Safety Verification of DNN-Controlled Systems
summary: Verifies DNN-controlled systems by synthesizing neural barrier certificates, first for almost-sure safety and, if that fails, for lower and upper bounds on probabilistic safety over finite and infinite horizons, using k-inductive certificates and simulation-guided training on four systems.

title: Verifying Global Two-Safety Properties in Neural Networks with Confidence
summary: Verifies confidence-based 2-safety properties of DNNs, such as global robustness and global fairness, by self-composition with a new verifiable abstraction of softmax, proven sound and implemented on top of Marabou with evaluation on public benchmarks.

title: POLICEd RL: Learning Closed-Loop Robot Control Policies with Provable Satisfaction of Hard Constraints
summary: POLICEd RL learns robot control policies that provably satisfy affine hard state constraints with a black-box environment by making the policy affine around the unsafe set as a repulsive buffer; it works with any RL training algorithm and outperforms existing methods.

title: 1-Lipschitz Layers Compared: Memory, Speed, and Certifiable Robustness
summary: Compares 1-Lipschitz layer methods for certifiably robust networks on computational complexity, memory, time per epoch, accuracy and certified robust accuracy, and gives guidelines for choosing a method based on the available resources.

title: MMCert: Provable Defense Against Adversarial Attacks to Multi-Modal Models
summary: MMCert is a certified defense for multi-modal models that lower-bounds performance under bounded perturbations to every modality, such as changed pixels in RGB and depth images; on road segmentation and emotion recognition it beats a certified defense extended from unimodal models.

title: Towards General Robustness Verification of MaxPool-Based Convolutional Neural Networks via Tightening Linear Approximation
summary: MaxLin verifies robustness of MaxPool-based CNNs by tightening the linear approximation of MaxPool to certify larger lower bounds; on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet networks it improves the certified bound by up to 110.60% with up to 5.13x speedup.

title: Universal Robustness via Median Randomized Smoothing for Real-World Super-Resolution
summary: Compares robustness methods for real-world image super-resolution and finds median randomized smoothing generalizes across adversarial attacks better than adversarial training, while also helping SR models handle blur, Gaussian noise and natural real-world corruptions.

title: Input-Relational Verification of Deep Neural Networks
summary: RaVeN verifies input-relational DNN properties such as universal adversarial perturbation robustness and monotonicity with DiffPoly, an abstract domain tracking output differences between executions at every layer, combined with linear programming; it is substantially more precise than baselines.

title: A Recipe for Improved Certifiable Robustness
summary: Improves Lipschitz-based deterministic certification by exploring the design space, adding large Cholesky-orthogonalized residual dense layers to Lipschitz-controlled ResNets and filtered generative data augmentation, raising the best deterministic VRA by up to 8.5 percentage points.

title: Certified Adversarial Robustness for Rate Encoded Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Gives the first provable l1-norm robustness guarantee for rate-encoded spiking neural networks by linking rate encoding to randomized smoothing, and adds adversarial training that improves empirical robust accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100.

title: COLEP: Certifiably Robust Learning-Reasoning Conformal Prediction via Probabilistic Circuits
summary: COLEP certifies the coverage of conformal prediction under bounded adversarial perturbations by combining learned semantic models with reasoning via probabilistic circuits; certified coverage improves by up to 12% on GTSRB, 9% on CIFAR-10 and 14% on AwA2.

title: DRSM: De-Randomized Smoothing on Malware Classifier Providing Certified Robustness
summary: DRSM certifies malware detectors against contiguous adversarial bytes by adapting de-randomized smoothing to MalConv with a window ablation scheme, at a marginal accuracy cost, and releases PACE, a public dataset of 15.5K benign executables.

title: Expressive Losses for Verified Robustness via Convex Combinations
summary: Argues that loss expressivity, spanning lower and upper bounds of the worst-case loss through one coefficient, is key to verified training, showing simple convex combinations of adversarial attacks and IBP bounds reach state-of-the-art verified robustness across settings.

title: Expressivity of ReLU-Networks under Convex Relaxations
summary: Studies how expressive ReLU networks are under common convex relaxations, showing more precise relaxations can exactly analyze more univariate functions, yet no single-neuron relaxation precisely analyzes ReLU networks for multivariate convex monotone piecewise-linear functions.

title: GNNCert: Deterministic Certification of Graph Neural Networks against Adversarial Perturbations
summary: GNNCert deterministically certifies graph classifiers against bounded perturbations to both graph structure and node features, guaranteeing the same label when perturbed edges and feature-perturbed nodes are limited; on 8 benchmark datasets it outperforms three prior methods.

title: Incremental Randomized Smoothing Certification
summary: IRS incrementally certifies modified models, such as quantized or pruned versions, under randomized smoothing by reusing the original smoothed model's guarantees with very few samples, achieving up to 3x speedup over recertifying from scratch.

title: Interpreting Robustness Proofs of Deep Neural Networks
summary: Generates human-understandable interpretations of DNN robustness proofs, revealing that proofs for standard networks rely on spurious features, provably robust training filters out even meaningful features, and combined adversarial and provable training best balances the two.

title: LipSim: A Provably Robust Perceptual Similarity Metric
summary: LipSim is a perceptual similarity metric built on 1-Lipschitz networks that certifies its output against all l2-bounded perturbations, after showing ViT ensemble-based metrics are vulnerable to attacks; evaluated on natural and certified scores and image retrieval.

title: Mitigating the Curse of Dimensionality for Certified Robustness via Dual Randomized Smoothing
summary: Dual Randomized Smoothing down-samples an image into two sub-images and smooths each in lower dimension, proving a tight l2 certified radius for the original input that shrinks more slowly with dimension; improves accuracy and certified robustness on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

title: Novel Quadratic Constraints for Extending LipSDP beyond Slope-Restricted Activations
summary: Extends LipSDP to GroupSort, MaxMin and Householder activations with new quadratic constraints, giving a unified SDP for l2 and l-infinity Lipschitz bounds of residual, non-residual and implicit networks that is less conservative than existing approaches.

title: On the Scalability and Memory Efficiency of Semidefinite Programs for Lipschitz Constant Estimation of Neural Networks
summary: Recasts SDP-based Lipschitz constant estimation as an eigenvalue optimization solvable by first-order methods in autodiff frameworks, via redundant quadratic constraints and Lagrangian and Shor relaxations, using far less memory and scaling to large ImageNet networks.

title: Provably Robust Conformal Prediction with Improved Efficiency
summary: Fixes the flawed guarantee of randomized smoothed conformal prediction with RSCP+, certifying coverage of conformal prediction sets under adversarial noise, and adds Post-Training Transformation and Robust Conformal Training to shrink sets, improving efficiency up to 16.9x on ImageNet.

title: The Lipschitz-Variance-Margin Tradeoff for Enhanced Randomized Smoothing
summary: Improves randomized smoothing certificates by analysing how Monte-Carlo variance interacts with the base classifier's Lipschitz constant and margin, using a new logit-to-probability mapping, Bernstein's inequality and tighter Lipschitz bounds; raises certified accuracy and works zero-shot on pre-trained models.

title: Understanding Certified Training with Interval Bound Propagation
summary: Studies why interval bound propagation (IBP) certified training works, using a new bound-tightness metric; derives conditions for exact IBP bounds that explain the robustness-accuracy trade-off, finds wider ReLU networks perform better, and shows tightness is neither necessary nor sufficient for certifiable robustness.

title: VeRe: Verification Guided Synthesis for Repairing Deep Neural Networks
summary: VeRe repairs deep neural networks by using linear-relaxation-based verification to localize faulty neurons symbolically and then optimizing their parameters; it cuts backdoor attack success from 98.47% to 0.38% on average and repairs all 36 safety-property tasks.

title: FCert: Certifiably Robust Few-Shot Classification in the Era of Foundation Models
summary: FCert is a certified defense against data poisoning of few-shot classifiers built on foundation models, provably keeping the predicted label when the number of poisoned support samples is bounded; it outperforms existing certified poisoning defenses on vision and text benchmarks.

title: It's Simplex! Disaggregating Measures to Improve Certified Robustness
summary: Argues that aggregate metrics hide per-sample behaviour of certified robustness and proposes dataset-independent and dataset-dependent analyses based on the output space of certified models; these lead to new certification approaches that certify 9% more samples at noise scale σ = 1.

title: Node-aware Bi-smoothing: Certified Robustness against Graph Injection Attacks
summary: Node-aware bi-smoothing certifies node classification against graph injection attacks with a model-agnostic smoothing scheme covering both evasion and poisoning; it derives certifiable conditions, extends two existing certification frameworks to node injection for comparison, and is also applied to recommendation systems.

title: Text-CRS: A Generalized Certified Robustness Framework against Textual Adversarial Attacks
summary: Text-CRS certifies text classifiers against synonym substitution, word reordering, insertion and deletion via randomized smoothing, modelling each word-level operation as permutation plus embedding transformation with tailored noise distributions; it also gives the first certified accuracy benchmark for these four operations.

title: Axiomatic Aggregations of Abductive Explanations
summary: Aggregates the many valid abductive explanations of a prediction into feature importance scores, using two power indices from cooperative game theory and a causal strength measure, each characterized axiomatically; the resulting scores resist attacks that fool SHAP and LIME.

title: DeepSaDe: Learning Neural Networks That Guarantee Domain Constraint Satisfaction
summary: DeepSaDe trains neural networks that provably satisfy domain constraints on all predictions, extending constraint-satisfaction-based learning of linear models with constraint propagation across layers and weight updates that mix gradient descent and CSP solving; it enforces varied constraints across several tasks.

title: Delivering Inflated Explanations
summary: Defines inflated abductive explanations, which give each selected feature a set of values under which the decision stays unchanged, making formal explanations more informative; they cost little more than abductive explanations to compute, and duality results extend to them.

title: DRF: Improving Certified Robustness via Distributional Robustness Framework
summary: DRF links adversarial-training-based randomized smoothing methods to distributional robustness, showing they are special cases of its framework; this gives control over the trade-off between clean accuracy and certified robustness of smoothed classifiers and substantially improves certified robustness.

title: REGLO: Provable Neural Network Repair for Global Robustness Properties
summary: REGLO repairs pretrained ReLU networks to satisfy global robustness and individual fairness; it proves counterexamples must have large gradients, uses this to find violating linear regions, and solves a robust convex optimization problem for a minimal weight change that provably repairs them.

title: Robustness Verification of Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Control Systems Using Reward Martingales
summary: Verifies robustness of deep reinforcement learning control systems under state perturbations with reward martingales, giving certified bounds on expected cumulative reward and on its tails; the martingales are trained as neural networks, and the bounds tightly enclose simulation outcomes.

title: TextGuard: Provable Defense against Backdoor Attacks on Text Classification
summary: TextGuard is a provable defense against backdoor attacks on text classification: it splits training sentences into sub-sentences to form sub-training sets, trains an ensemble, and guarantees unchanged predictions when the trigger length is below a threshold, beating prior certified defenses.

title: ReLU Hull Approximation
summary: WraLU over-approximates the convex hull of ReLU for neural network verification by wrapping it in a polytope whose upper faces are built from the edges and vertices of the lower faces; integrated into PRIMA, it cuts LP constraints by up to half without losing precision.

title: (Provable) Adversarial Robustness for Group Equivariant Tasks: Graphs, Point Clouds, Molecules, and More
summary: Defines adversarial robustness that accounts for task equivariances such as rotation or permutation, and shows it is provable with equivariant models plus standard certification; introduces equivariance-preserving randomized smoothing and the first graph edit distance certificates for node classification.

title: Asymmetric Certified Robustness via Feature-Convex Neural Networks
summary: Feature-convex neural networks, composing an input-convex network with a Lipschitz feature map, give deterministic closed-form certified radii for any ℓp norm on a sensitive class in asymmetric binary classification, reaching state-of-the-art certified ℓ1 radii on malware and image datasets efficiently.

title: Boosting Verification of Deep Reinforcement Learning via Piece-Wise Linear Decision Neural Networks
CBD: A Certified Backdoor Detector Based on Local Dominant Probability
summary: CBD is a certified backdoor detector based on conformal prediction with a local dominant probability statistic, giving detection conditions and a false positive rate bound; for ℓ2-bounded random triggers it reaches certified true positive rates up to 98% on GTSRB and CIFAR-10.

title: Certifiably Robust Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Certifies robustness of graph contrastive learning against structure and attribute attacks with RES (Randomized Edgedrop Smoothing), which works for any GCL model and preserves the certificate in downstream tasks; also proposes a training method for robust GCL.

title: Certification of Distributional Individual Fairness
summary: Certifies distributional individual fairness of neural networks, guaranteeing fair predictions for all distributions in a γ-Wasserstein ball around the data, via a convex approximation of individual fairness constraints and quasi-convex optimization; scales to networks orders of magnitude larger than prior work.

title: Certified Robustness via Dynamic Margin Maximization and Improved Lipschitz Regularization
summary: Trains certifiably robust classifiers by enlarging the logit margin while regularizing the Lipschitz constant along vulnerable directions, using a scalable method for differentiable guaranteed Lipschitz upper bounds; reports competitive improvements on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Tiny-ImageNet.

title: Compositional Policy Learning in Stochastic Control Systems with Formal Guarantees
summary: Learns compositions of neural network policies for stochastic control with a formal certificate that a SpectRL specification holds with a target probability, using reach-avoid supermartingales per sub-task and a tighter reach-avoid probability bound; evaluated on Stochastic Nine Rooms.

title: Connecting Certified and Adversarial Training
summary: Combines IBP and PGD in TAPS, an unsound certified training method that optimizes more precise worst-case loss approximations to reduce over-regularization, raising both certified and standard accuracy and setting a new state of the art in many settings, such as 22% certified accuracy on TinyImageNet at ℓ∞ radius 1/255.

title: Exact Verification of ReLU Neural Control Barrier Functions
summary: Exactly verifies safety of ReLU neural control barrier functions using a generalized Nagumo theorem for nonsmooth boundaries: the barrier is split into linear segments, each checked by a nonlinear program, with pruning by IBP and linear relaxation; compared against SMT-based methods.

title: Exploiting Connections between Lipschitz Structures for Certifiably Robust Deep Equilibrium Models
Hierarchical Randomized Smoothing
summary: Hierarchical randomized smoothing certifies models against adversaries that perturb only a subset of entities, such as pixels or nodes, by adding noise to a randomly chosen subset of entities; it gives certificates for discrete and continuous domains with better robustness-accuracy trade-offs.

title: Multi-scale Diffusion Denoised Smoothing
summary: Improves denoised smoothing with diffusion models by selectively smoothing across multiple noise scales with one diffusion model, plus fine-tuning it to denoise consistently when the image is recoverable; this gives strong certified robustness at high noise while keeping accuracy near non-smoothed classifiers.

title: Neural Lyapunov Control for Discrete-Time Systems
summary: Learns provably stable neural Lyapunov controllers for discrete-time nonlinear systems, verifying Lyapunov conditions with mixed-integer linear programming, computing verified sublevel sets and finding counterexamples by gradient search; it beats baselines by an order of magnitude on path tracking.

title: Provably Bounding Neural Network Preimages
summary: INVPROP over-approximates neural network preimages, the inputs that lead to a linearly constrained output set, on GPU without an LP solver and with branch-and-bound; in some settings it is over 2500x tighter and 2.5x faster than prior work, and ships in α,β-CROWN.

title: RS-Del: Edit Distance Robustness Certificates for Sequence Classifiers via Randomized Deletion
summary: RS-Del certifies sequence classifiers against edit-distance-bounded adversaries via randomized deletion smoothing, with a certification proof built on longest common subsequences; on the MalConv malware detector it reaches 91% certified accuracy at an edit distance radius of 128 bytes.

title: Stability Guarantees for Feature Attributions with Multiplicative Smoothing
summary: Multiplicative Smoothing (MuS) makes a classifier Lipschitz with respect to feature masking, which provably yields relaxed stability guarantees for feature attributions; it works with any classifier and attribution method, including LIME and SHAP, on vision and language models.

title: Temporal Robustness against Data poisoning
summary: Proposes a temporal threat model for data poisoning based on data timestamps, with earliness and duration metrics, defines temporal robustness, provides a benchmark simulating continual data collection, and gives a temporal aggregation baseline with provable temporal robustness even against unbounded poisoned samples.

title: UniT: A Unified Look at Certified Robust Training against Text Adversarial Perturbation
Unlocking Deterministic Robustness Certification on ImageNet
summary: Scales deterministic Lipschitz-based robustness certification to ImageNet with the LiResNet architecture, whose residual block admits tight Lipschitz bounds, and the EMMA loss that penalizes worst-case adversaries from all classes; also gives the best ℓ2 certified accuracy on CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny-ImageNet.

title: VeriX: Towards Verified Explainability of Deep Neural Networks
summary: VeriX computes optimal robust explanations and counterfactuals along decision boundaries of machine learning models, building them iteratively with constraint solving and a feature-level sensitivity ranking heuristic; evaluated on image recognition benchmarks and autonomous aircraft taxiing.

title: Unraveling the Connections between Privacy and Certified Robustness in Federated Learning Against Poisoning Attacks
summary: Studies how differential privacy in federated learning yields certified robustness against poisoning, giving certified prediction and certified attack inefficacy at user and instance levels; stronger privacy improves certified attack inefficacy but not necessarily certified prediction.

title: TrajPAC: Towards Robustness Verification of Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction Models
summary: TrajPAC verifies robustness of pedestrian trajectory prediction models with a probably approximately correct (PAC) framework, after formally defining label and pure robustness; it finds counterexamples and evaluates Trajectron++, MemoNet, AgentFormer and MID on ETH/UCY and Stanford Drone scenes.

title: Deep Learning Robustness Verification for Few-Pixel Attacks
summary: Calzone is a sound and complete L0 (few-pixel) robustness verifier that predicts the largest provable pixel-set size, covers the image with covering designs and checks each set with an L∞ verifier; it typically finishes in minutes, while a MILP baseline fails at t=3.

title: Perception Contracts for Safety of ML-Enabled Systems
summary: Introduces perception contracts, bounds on perception errors that preserve safety invariants of controllers using neural perception, with symbolic learning algorithms that synthesize them from images; evaluated on lane tracking for an electric vehicle and a crop-row-following agricultural robot.

title: Expediting Neural Network Verification via Network Reduction
summary: Speeds up neural network verification by removing stable ReLU neurons and converting networks into sequential ReLU and affine layers before verification; applied with α,β-crown, VeriNet and PRIMA, it shrinks networks, accelerates verification and lets tools handle more architectures.

title: HOBAT: Batch Verification for Homogeneous Structural Neural Networks
summary: HOBAT verifies batches of structurally homogeneous neural networks, such as candidates produced by continual learning, by abstracting same-position neurons across the batch into one neuron and refining iteratively; combined with bound propagation, it significantly improves on the vanilla approach.

title: Cardinality-Minimal Explanations for Monotonic Neural Networks
summary: Shows that cardinality-minimal abductive and contrastive explanations, intractable in general and still hard for monotonic networks, become computable in polynomial time by greedy algorithms when activations are continuous and almost everywhere differentiable; experiments indicate favourable performance.

title: Formal Explanations of Neural Network Policies for Planning
summary: Formulates formal explanations for sequences of decisions made by neural network planning policies and shows that, under assumptions, a minimal explanation needs a number of single-decision explanation problems linear in sequence length; implemented for ASNet policies on classical planning domains.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Probabilistic Logic Shields
summary: Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) shields deep RL agents by encoding safety constraints as differentiable functions through probabilistic logic programming, works with any policy gradient algorithm while keeping convergence guarantees, and learns safer, higher-reward policies than other shielding methods.

title: The #DNN-Verification Problem: Counting Unsafe Inputs for Deep Neural Networks
summary: Defines #DNN-Verification, counting the inputs that violate a safety property of a deep neural network; shows #P-completeness, gives an exact counting method and a randomized approximate method with a provable probabilistic bound, evaluated on safety-critical benchmarks.

title: DiffSmooth: Certifiably Robust Learning via Diffusion Models and Local Smoothing
summary: DiffSmooth certifies classifiers by purifying inputs with diffusion models and then applying local smoothing, backed by analysis bounding recovered instances near the original; it raises certified ImageNet accuracy at ℓ2 radius 1.5 from 36.0% to 53.0%.

title: PATROL: Provable Defense against Adversarial Policy in Two-player Games
PORE: Provably Robust Recommender Systems against Data Poisoning Attacks
summary: PORE makes any recommender system provably robust to untargeted data poisoning: it guarantees that at least r of the top-N items recommended without attack remain recommended, where r depends on the number of fake users and is computed efficiently per user.

title: Precise and Generalized Robustness Certification for Neural Networks
summary: GCERT certifies neural network robustness against semantic image mutations, such as weather filters, style transfer and perceptual changes, by expressing them as directions in a generative model's latent space; it plugs into complete, incomplete and quantitative certification frameworks.

title: A Robust Optimisation Perspective on Counterexample-Guided Repair of Neural Networks
summary: Views counterexample-guided neural network repair as robust optimisation, proving termination for restricted models and disproving it in general; empirically shows common verifiers and falsifiers still suit repair, and gives a quadratic-programming repair algorithm for linear regression.

title: BNN-DP: Robustness Certification of Bayesian Neural Networks via Dynamic Programming
summary: Certifies adversarial robustness of Bayesian neural networks by viewing them as stochastic dynamical systems and using dynamic programming with bound propagation and convex relaxations to over-approximate the prediction range with piecewise affine functions; BNN-DP beats prior methods by up to four orders of magnitude in bound tightness and speed.

title: Certifying Ensembles: A General Certification Theory with S-Lipschitzness
summary: Introduces S-Lipschitz classifiers, a generalization of Lipschitz continuity, to analyse certified robustness of ensembles, deriving precise conditions under which an ensemble of robust classifiers is more robust, or less robust, than each of its members.

title: Dimension-independent Certified Neural Network Watermarks via Mollifier Smoothing
summary: Certifies neural network watermarks against ℓp-norm removal attacks for all p from 1 to infinity with mollifier smoothing, whose certified radius is independent of parameter dimension; a PDE-based approximation reduces the sampling and numerical integration cost.

title: Direct Parameterization of Lipschitz-Bounded Deep Networks
summary: Gives a direct, complete parameterization of fully-connected and convolutional networks meeting the SDP-based ℓ2 Lipschitz bound, as sandwich layers trainable with standard gradient methods; outperforms prior approaches on empirical and certified robust accuracy in image classification.

title: Efficient Bound of Lipschitz Constant for Convolutional Layers by Gram Iteration
summary: Gram iteration gives a precise, fast, differentiable upper bound on the spectral norm of convolutional layers via circulant matrix theory, converging superlinearly; it beats other methods in precision, cost and scalability and works well for Lipschitz regularization of CNNs.

title: FARE: Provably Fair Representation Learning with Practical Certificates
summary: Learns fair representations with practical certificates by restricting the encoder's representation space, instantiated with fair trees, and a statistical procedure giving a finite-sample high-confidence upper bound on the unfairness of any downstream classifier; FARE's certificates are tight and often comparable to prior methods' empirical results.

title: Improving l1-Certified Robustness via Randomized Smoothing by Leveraging Box Constraints
summary: Improves ℓ1-certified robustness of randomized smoothing by deriving certification formulae that exploit the fact that adversarial images must lie in the image space [0,1]^d, giving significant gains without changing classifiers or smoothing distributions.

title: Robust One-Class Classification with Signed Distance Function using 1-Lipschitz Neural Networks
summary: OCSDF performs one-class classification by learning the signed distance function to a distribution's support with 1-Lipschitz networks, giving ℓ2 robustness bounds and a certified AUROC metric; it is competitive on tabular and image data while much more robust to attacks.

title: Run-off Election: Improved Provable Defense against Data Poisoning Attacks
summary: Run-Off Election aggregates ensemble defenses against data poisoning with a two-round vote using base models' logits, yielding DPA+ROE and FA+ROE; certified accuracy improves by up to 3-4% on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and GTSRB, and 12-27% with boosted DPA.

title: Tight Certification of Adversarially Trained Neural Networks via Nonconvex Low-Rank Semidefinite Relaxations
summary: Certifies adversarially trained networks with a nonconvex low-rank restriction of the SDP relaxation, matching expensive SDP certificates with far fewer variables and reaching global optimality via local optimization in polynomial time; it nearly closes the gap to exact certification.

title: A Tale of Two Approximations: Tightening Over-Approximation for DNN Robustness Verification via Under-Approximation
summary: DualApp tightens linear over-approximations of activation functions for DNN robustness verification by using an under-approximated actual domain, computed via Monte Carlo simulation or gradient descent; it improves verified robustness ratio by 100%-1000% and certified lower bounds by 10.64% on average.

title: Hybrid Controller Synthesis for Nonlinear Systems Subject to Reach-Avoid Constraints
summary: Synthesizes provably correct hybrid polynomial-DNN controllers for nonlinear systems with reach-avoid requirements, combining RL, low-degree polynomial fitting and knowledge distillation, and solving constrained optimization for barrier certificates and Lyapunov-like functions; evaluated on benchmarks including high-dimensional systems.

title: NNV 2.0: The Neural Network Verification Tool
summary: NNV 2.0 extends the NNV verification tool to neural ODEs, semantic segmentation and recurrent networks, adds cheaper reachability methods and VNNLIB and ONNX support, and verifies safety and robustness across control, segmentation, image classification and time-series benchmarks, compared with a commercial product.

title: QEBVerif: Quantization Error Bound Verification of Neural Networks
summary: QEBVerif verifies quantization error bounds between a DNN and its fully quantized counterpart, using differential reachability analysis layer by layer and falling back to an equivalent MILP encoding when that fails, making the method sound and complete.

title: Verifying Generalization in Deep Learning
summary: Uses DNN verification to judge how well DNN decision rules generalize to new input domains, measuring agreement among independently trained networks on that domain; evaluated on three deep reinforcement learning benchmarks, including Internet congestion control.

title: Boosting Verified Training for Robust Image Classifications via Abstraction
summary: Certified training that maps perturbed images to intervals before training, smoothing the loss landscape, and enables sound and complete black-box verification; it reduces verified errors by up to 95.64%, gives up to 602.50x speedup and scales to 138-million-parameter models.

title: Efficient Verification of Neural Networks Against LVM-Based Specifications
summary: Verifies neural networks against specifications defined by latent variable models that capture pose, viewpoint and occlusion changes, by attaching an invertible encoding head so latent-space sets can be verified with little reconstruction overhead; scales largely independently of input dimension.

title: PointCert: Point Cloud Classification with Deterministic Certified Robustness Guarantees
summary: PointCert turns any point cloud classifier into one with deterministic certified robustness, keeping the label when fewer than a threshold number of points are added, deleted or modified; it outperforms probabilistic certified defenses on ModelNet and ScanObjectNN.

title: Abstract Interpretation of Fixpoint Iterators with Applications to Neural Networks
summary: CRAFT over-approximates fixpoints of numerical iterators via abstract interpretation without joins, using a new CH-Zonotope domain; on monDEQ neural networks it is two orders of magnitude faster, one order more scalable and 25% higher in certified accuracy than prior work.

title: Architecture-Preserving Provable Repair of Deep Neural Networks
summary: APRNN provably repairs DNNs over V-polytope specifications by changing only parameters, possibly across multiple layers, in polynomial time, supporting piecewise-linear activations and convolutional, pooling and residual layers; it beats PRDNN and REASSURE on MNIST, ImageNet and ACAS Xu.

title: Incremental Verification of Neural Networks
summary: IVAN makes complete DNN verification incremental, reusing work from verifying the original network when it is updated, via new theory, data structures and algorithms; it achieves geometric mean speedups of 2.4x on MNIST and CIFAR10 and 3.8x on ACAS-XU.

title: (Certified!!) Adversarial Robustness for Free!
summary: Achieves certified ℓ2 robustness with only off-the-shelf models through denoised smoothing that pairs a pretrained diffusion model with a standard classifier, certifying 71% ImageNet accuracy at radius 0.5, 14 points above the prior best, without fine-tuning.

title: A Unified Algebraic Perspective on Lipschitz Neural Networks
summary: Unifies many 1-Lipschitz layer designs as analytical solutions of a common SDP condition and, with the Gershgorin circle theorem, derives new parameterizations called SDP-based Lipschitz Layers (SLL), which outperform previous approaches in certified robust accuracy on image classification.

title: Certifiably Robust Policy Learning against Adversarial Multi-Agent Communication
Certified Defences Against Adversarial Patch Attacks on Semantic Segmentation
summary: Demasked Smoothing certifies semantic segmentation models against adversarial patches without retraining or architecture changes, supporting certified detection and recovery; on ADE20K it certifies 64% of pixel predictions for a 1% patch in detection and 48% for a 0.5% patch in recovery.

title: Certified Training: Small Boxes are All You Need
summary: Trains certifiably robust networks with SABR, which propagates interval bounds over a small, carefully selected subset of the adversarial input region to approximate the worst-case loss with less approximation error, outperforming existing certified defenses in both standard and certified accuracy across perturbation sizes and datasets.

title: Denoising Masked Autoencoders Help Robust Classification
summary: Denoising Masked AutoEncoders (DMAE) pre-train a Transformer encoder to reconstruct images corrupted by Gaussian noise and masking, then use it as the base classifier for Gaussian smoothing; DMAE ViT-Large sets new certified accuracy records on ImageNet and transfers to CIFAR-10.

title: DensePure: Understanding Diffusion Models for Adversarial Robustness
Efficient Certified Training and Robustness Verification of Neural ODEs
summary: Verifies and certifiably trains high-dimensional neural ODEs with GAINS, which combines ODE solvers with variable but discrete time steps, a graph representation of solver trajectories and an abstraction over that graph, cutting runtime from O(exp(d)+exp(T)) to O(d+T² log²T); evaluated on MNIST, FMNIST and PHYSIO-NET.

title: Fundamental Limits in Formal Verification of Message-Passing Neural Networks
summary: Proves that output reachability of graph-classifier message-passing neural networks over unbounded graphs cannot be formally verified, while output reachability and adversarial robustness of node-classifier MPNNs become verifiable when the degree of input graphs is bounded in advance.

title: Localized Randomized Smoothing for Collective Robustness Certification
summary: Localized randomized smoothing gives collective robustness certificates for multi-output models such as segmentation and node classification, scaling noise per input region by its importance to each output; it Pareto-dominates existing certificates in accuracy and certificate strength.

title: On the Perils of Cascading Robust Classifiers
summary: Shows that the robustness certifier of cascading ensembles of certifiably robust networks is unsound and presents the CasA attack, which finds adversarial inputs for up to 88% of samples claimed certifiably robust and drops accuracy to as low as 11%.

title: Provable Defense Against Geometric Transformations
summary: Provides the first deterministic certified training against geometric transformations such as scaling and rotation, using a GPU-optimized verifier 60x to 42,600x faster than existing ones; trained networks reach top certified geometric robustness and clean accuracy, including for autonomous driving.

title: Provable Robustness against Wasserstein Distribution Shifts via Input Randomization
Robust Explanation Constraints for Neural Networks
summary: Certifies the robustness of gradient-based explanations against bounded input or parameter manipulation by propagating symbolic intervals through forward and backward passes; the differentiable bounds enable training, yielding explanation-robustness certificates on all six datasets tested.

title: Sound Randomized Smoothing in Floating-Point Arithmetic
Towards Robustness Certification Against Universal Perturbations
summary: Certifies neural network robustness against universal perturbations shared across all samples, combining linear relaxation-based perturbation analysis with MILP, plus population-level error bounds from a sampled batch; supports comparing defenses and detecting backdoor target classes.

title: Wasserstein Auto-encoded MDPs: Formal Verification of Efficiently Distilled RL Policies with Many-sided Guarantees
summary: WAE-MDP distils RL policies into discrete latent models by minimising a penalised optimal-transport distance, giving bisimulation guarantees so formal verification transfers to the distilled policy; distillation runs up to 10 times faster with better latent model quality.

title: Fairify: Fairness Verification of Neural Networks
summary: Fairify verifies individual fairness of neural networks with SMT, partitioning the input domain and pruning neurons per partition via interval arithmetic and activation heuristics to return certificates or counterexamples; evaluated on 25 real-world networks from four sources.

title: ObjectSeeker: Certifiably Robust Object Detection against Patch Hiding Attacks via Patch-agnostic Masking
summary: ObjectSeeker certifies object detectors against patch hiding attacks through patch-agnostic masking that removes the patch without knowing its shape, size or location; certified robustness improves by about 10-40% absolute over prior work with roughly 1% clean performance drop.

title: RAB: Provable Robustness Against Backdoor Attacks
summary: RAB certifies robustness against backdoor attacks through a randomized smoothing framework and smoothed training with a proven tight bound, plus an exact smooth-training algorithm for K-NN; gives the first certified backdoor robustness benchmark on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and ImageNette.

title: SoK: Certified Robustness for Deep Neural Networks
summary: Systematization of certifiably robust approaches for deep neural networks: a taxonomy of robustness verification and robust training methods, their strengths, limits and connections, open challenges, and an open-source platform benchmarking more than 20 representative approaches.

title: One-Shot Reachability Analysis of Neural Network Dynamical Systems
summary: Reachability analysis of neural network dynamical systems that verifies the unrolled system in one shot rather than recursively propagating bounds, proven to reduce compounding over-approximation error; the performance gap is characterised and demonstrated on a cart-pole system.

title: ReachLipBnB: A branch-and-bound method for reachability analysis of neural autonomous systems using Lipschitz bounds
summary: ReachLipBnB computes reachable sets of neural networks and neural-network-controlled systems using directional Lipschitz bounds from a convex program inside branch-and-bound, with PCA on sampled trajectories to choose polyhedral directions; evaluated in open- and closed-loop settings.

title: CertiFair: A Framework for Certified Global Fairness of Neural Networks
summary: CertiFair is a sound and complete verifier for global individual fairness of ReLU classifiers under distance-based similarity, returning counterexamples when violated, plus a fairness loss for provably fair training; global individual fairness improves by 96% without significant accuracy loss.

title: Confidence-Aware Training of Smoothed Classifiers for Certified Robustness
summary: Training method for randomized-smoothing classifiers that uses accuracy under Gaussian noise as a per-sample proxy for robustness, filtering out samples unlikely to benefit from the adversarial objective; consistently improves certified l2 robustness over earlier training methods.

title: Eliminating the Impossible, Whatever Remains Must Be True: On Extracting and Applying Background Knowledge in the Context of Formal Explanations
summary: Uses background knowledge extracted from data with rule induction to make formal explanations of ML predictions shorter for why questions and more accurate for why-not questions, dropping the assumption that features are independent and uniformly distributed.

title: Enhancing the Antidote: Improved Pointwise Certifications against Poisoning Attacks
summary: Pointwise certification against poisoning attacks that modify a bounded number of training samples, built on differential privacy and the Sampled Gaussian Mechanism; the certified robustness guarantees are more than twice as large as those of earlier certifications.

title: Learning Control Policies for Stochastic Systems with Reach-Avoid Guarantees
summary: Learns controllers for discrete-time nonlinear stochastic systems with infinite-horizon probabilistic reach-avoid guarantees, using neural reach-avoid supermartingales as certificates; supports learning policies from scratch, verifying fixed policies or fine-tuning, validated on 3 stochastic RL tasks.

title: Solving Explainability Queries with Quantification: The Case of Feature Relevancy
summary: Algorithm for the feature relevancy problem, deciding whether a feature can appear in some explanation of a prediction, applicable to any classifier meeting minor requirements; on random forests it outperforms QBF solvers by orders of magnitude.

title: BARS: Local Robustness Certification for Deep Learning based Traffic Analysis Systems
summary: BARS certifies local robustness of deep-learning traffic analysis systems via boundary-adaptive randomized smoothing, optimising noise shape and scale with a Distribution Transformer and gradient-based search; gives tighter guarantees than baselines on three practical traffic analysis systems.

title: A Quantitative Geometric Approach to Neural-Network Smoothness
summary: Quantitative geometric framework for Lipschitz constant estimation of neural networks, yielding hardness and approximability results and SDP-based algorithms in the tool GeoLIP, which is more scalable and precise than existing tools for l-infinity perturbations.

title: Accelerating Certified Robustness Training via Knowledge Transfer
summary: Certified Robustness Transfer (CRT) cuts the cost of certified training by transferring robustness from a robust teacher to a student through a new loss; on CIFAR-10 it speeds training by 8x on average with comparable robustness, and scales to ImageNet.

title: BagFlip: A Certified Defense Against Data Poisoning
summary: BagFlip is a model-agnostic certified defense against data poisoning that handles both trigger-less and backdoor attacks; on image classification and malware detection it matches or beats prior approaches for trigger-less attacks and beats them for backdoor attacks.

title: Certifying Robust Graph Classification under Orthogonal Gromov-Wasserstein Threats
Certifying Some Distributional Fairness with Subpopulation Decomposition
summary: Certifies distributional fairness of ML models by bounding performance loss on fairness-constrained distributions near the training distribution, decomposing data into analytical subpopulations with convex subproblems; tight under sensitive shifting and non-trivial under general shifting on six datasets.

title: CoPur: Certifiably Robust Collaborative Inference via Feature Purification
Double Bubble, Toil and Trouble: Enhancing Certified Robustness through Transitivity
summary: Improves randomized-smoothing l2 certificates by exploiting transitivity of certifications and input-space geometry, called Geometrically-Informed Certified Robustness; certifications improve for more than 80% of Tiny-Imagenet instances, by 5% on average.

title: Efficiently Computing Local Lipschitz Constants of Neural Networks via Bound Propagation
summary: Computes l-infinity local Lipschitz constants of neural networks by linear bound propagation over a backward graph of the Clarke Jacobian, with tight relaxations and branch-and-bound; yields tighter bounds than relaxed methods and scales to larger models, with monotonicity analysis applications.

title: General Cutting Planes for Bound-Propagation-Based Neural Network Verification
summary: GCP-CROWN extends bound propagation in branch-and-bound neural network verification to arbitrary cutting planes, using cuts from MIP solvers on CPU alongside GPU bounding; first to fully solve oval20 and verifies twice as many oval21 instances as the best VNN-COMP 2021 tool.

title: Improved techniques for deterministic l2 robustness
summary: Improves deterministic l2 certified robustness of 1-Lipschitz CNNs by replacing the last linear layer with a 1-hidden-layer MLP, faster Skew Orthogonal Convolution training and new pooling layers; provable robust accuracy rises 3.82% on CIFAR-10 and 4.75% on CIFAR-100.

title: Improving Certified Robustness via Statistical Learning with Logical Reasoning
summary: Improves certified robustness by combining statistical ML models with logical rules through Markov logic networks; proves certifying MLN robustness is #P-hard, derives the first certified bound for MLN, and outperforms prior methods on five image and text datasets.

title: Invariance-Aware Randomized Smoothing Certificates
summary: Gray-box randomized smoothing certificates that exploit model invariances such as permutation and Euclidean isometries, using group orbits plus provably tight certificates; tight certificates give much stronger guarantees, while the orbit-based method is a good practical approximation.

title: Lethal Dose Conjecture on Data Poisoning
summary: Lethal Dose Conjecture: if n clean samples suffice for accurate prediction, only Theta(N/n) poisoned samples out of N can be tolerated; implies DPA and FA defenses are asymptotically optimal, and data augmentation doubles or triples DPA certified robustness on CIFAR-10 and GTSRB.

title: LOT: Layer-wise Orthogonal Training on Improving l2 Certified Robustness
summary: LOT trains 1-Lipschitz convolution layers by parametrising orthogonal matrices and computing inverse square roots in the Fourier domain, with semi-supervised learning; raises deterministic l2 certified robustness, e.g. from 59.04% to 63.50% on CIFAR-10 at radius 36/255.

title: MultiGuard: Provably Robust Multi-label Classification against Adversarial Examples
summary: MultiGuard certifies multi-label classifiers against l2-bounded adversarial perturbations by randomized smoothing with isotropic Gaussian noise, proving a number of ground-truth labels provably stay in the predicted set; evaluated on VOC 2007, MS-COCO and NUS-WIDE.

title: Neural Abstractions
summary: Safety verification of nonlinear dynamical models using neural networks as formal abstractions: CEGIS synthesises ReLU neural ODEs with certified error bounds, verified as affine hybrid automata in SpaceEx; performs comparably to Flow* and handles non-Lipschitz models.

title: Neural Lyapunov Control of Unknown Nonlinear Systems with Stability Guarantees
summary: Learns a neural controller for unknown nonlinear systems together with a neural Lyapunov function certifying a region of attraction, using one network to learn dynamics, another for the controller and Lyapunov function, and an SMT solver to verify Lyapunov conditions.

title: Pay attention to your loss : understanding misconceptions about Lipschitz neural networks
Provable Defense against Backdoor Policies in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Provable defense against backdoor policies in reinforcement learning that sanitises the policy by projecting observed states onto a safe subspace estimated from few clean interactions, achieving epsilon-approximate optimality under triggers with bounded sample needs; tested on two Atari games.

title: Provably Adversarially Robust Detection of Out-of-Distribution Data (Almost) for Free
Randomized Message-Interception Smoothing: Gray-box Certificates for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Gray-box randomized smoothing certificates for graph neural networks that randomly intercept messages and analyse whether adversarial nodes reach targets, certifying robustness against adversaries controlling entire nodes; graph sparsification further improves certifiable robustness.

title: Rethinking Lipschitz Neural Networks and Certified Robustness: A Boolean Function Perspective
summary: Studies certified l-infinity robustness of Lipschitz networks through Boolean function representation, proving impossibility results for standard Lipschitz networks and explaining how order statistics bypass them; a unified Lipschitz network gives better certified robustness across datasets and radii.

title: Safety Guarantees for Neural Network Dynamic Systems via Stochastic Barrier Functions
summary: Safety guarantees for neural network dynamic models via stochastic barrier functions synthesised by sum-of-squares optimisation over piecewise-linear NN bounds, giving a lower bound on safety probability, plus linear-programming control synthesis; scales to multi-layer models with hundreds of neurons per layer.

title: Shield Decentralization for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
Smoothed Embeddings for Certified Few-Shot Learning
summary: Extends randomized smoothing to few-shot learning models that map inputs to normalised embeddings, analysing their Lipschitz continuity to derive robustness certificates against l2-bounded perturbations; the theory is confirmed by experiments on several datasets.

title: Sound and Complete Verification of Polynomial Networks
summary: VPN is a sound and complete verifier for polynomial networks that pairs a new bounding method with branch and bound, producing much tighter bounds than IBP and DeepT-Fast; validated on MNIST, CIFAR10 and STL10.

title: Toward Robust Spiking Neural Network Against Adversarial Perturbation
summary: Certified robust training for spiking neural networks with S-IBP and S-CROWN, bound propagation methods handling spiking neuron nonlinearities, with bounds for digital and spike inputs; reduces attack error by up to 37.7% at 3.7% accuracy loss.

title: Zonotope Domains for Lagrangian Neural Network Verification
summary: Neural network verification that uses zonotopes within a Lagrangian decomposition, splitting a deep network into many 2-layer subproblems solved by efficient relaxations and dual ascent; bounds beat linear programming and Lagrangian-based methods in both time and tightness.

title: A Spectral View of Randomized Smoothing Under Common Corruptions: Benchmarking and Improving Certified Robustness
Almost-Orthogonal Layers for Efficient General-Purpose Lipschitz Networks
summary: Builds Lipschitz networks with almost-orthogonal layers, a rescaling-based weight parametrization that guarantees each fully-connected or convolutional layer has Lipschitz constant at most 1 without costly orthogonalization or inversion; certified robust accuracy on image classification is on par with most existing methods while being simpler and more broadly applicable.

title: Latent Space Smoothing for Individually Fair Representations
summary: LASSI learns representations that certify individual fairness for high-dimensional data, capturing similar individuals in a generative latent space, training with adversarial learning and applying randomized smoothing; certified individual fairness on real image data rises by up to 90%.

title: UniCR: Universally Approximated Certified Robustness via Randomized Smoothing
summary: Approximates randomized smoothing certificates for any input, classifier, ℓp perturbation and continuous noise distribution in UniCR, automating certification without case-by-case analysis and validating both the tightness of certified robustness and the optimality of the noise distribution; experiments show advantages over state-of-the-art certified defenses.

title: ViP: Unified Certified Detection and Recovery for Patch Attack with Vision Transformers
Proof transfer for fast certification of multiple approximate neural networks
summary: FANC transfers robustness proofs from a neural network to its quantized or pruned approximate versions by building templates, symbolic shapes at intermediate layers that capture the proof; verification with DeepZ speeds up by up to 4.1x.

title: Scalable verification of GNN-based job schedulers
summary: vegas verifies single-step and multi-step properties such as strategy-proofness, sharing incentive and stability of GNN-based job schedulers by combining abstraction, refinement, solvers and proof transfer; it gives significant speed-ups over earlier methods.

title: Provably Tightest Linear Approximation for Robustness Verification of Sigmoid-like Neural Networks
summary: Defines network-wise tightness for linear approximations of sigmoid-like activations in robustness verification and gives two efficient, provably tightest approximations; certified lower robustness bounds improve by up to 251.28%, with more precise results on convolutional networks.

title: QVIP: An ILP-based Formal Verification Approach for Quantized Neural Networks
summary: QVIP verifies quantized neural networks with a sound and complete encoding into integer linear constraints solved off the shelf, applied to local robustness and maximum robustness radius; it is two orders of magnitude faster than prior methods and solves more tasks.

title: Quantifying Safety of Learning-based Self-Driving Control Using Almost-Barrier Functions
summary: Quantifies safety of neural path-tracking controllers for self-driving by learning almost-barrier functions, certified with neural network robustness analysis in an adversarial learning-certification loop; also builds online safety monitors, tested from kinematic models up to the TORCS simulator.

title: PatchCleanser: Certifiably Robust Defense against Adversarial Patches for Any Image Classifier
summary: PatchCleanser certifies any image classifier against adversarial patches through two rounds of pixel masking; on ImageNet it reaches 83.9% top-1 clean accuracy and 62.1% certified robust accuracy against a 2%-pixel square patch.

title: A Dynamical System Perspective for Lipschitz Neural Networks
summary: Builds 1-Lipschitz neural networks by viewing residual networks as continuous-time dynamical systems, introducing the Convex Potential Layer from convex-potential ResNet flows; experiments show scalability and benefits as a provable l2 defense against adversarial examples.

title: CerDEQ: Certifiable Deep Equilibrium Model
summary: CerDEQ enables certified training of deep equilibrium models by bounding outputs through bound propagation with the adjoint DEQ, plus weight orthogonalisation; at epsilon 8/255 it reaches 64.72% certified error on CIFAR-10 and 94.45% on Tiny ImageNet.

title: Certified Adversarial Robustness Under the Bounded Support Set
summary: Generalises f-divergence-based randomized smoothing to Wasserstein and total-variation frameworks that handle smoothing measures with bounded support, such as uniform distributions; proves negative certified robustness results for lq perturbations, validated on CIFAR-10 with ResNet.

title: Certified Neural Network Watermarks with Randomized Smoothing
summary: Certifiable watermarking of neural networks using randomized smoothing over model parameters, guaranteeing the watermark cannot be removed unless parameters change by more than an l2 threshold; also more empirically robust than earlier watermarking methods.

title: Certified Robustness Against Natural Language Attacks by Causal Intervention
summary: CISS certifies NLP models against word substitution attacks by learning causal effects through smoothing in latent semantic space; on YELP its certified robustness beats the runner-up by 6.7%, with 79.4% empirical robustness under syntactic attacks.

title: Certifying Out-of-Domain Generalization for Blackbox Functions
summary: Certifies distributional robustness of black-box models with bounded losses using the Hellinger distance, scaling to ImageNet and non-smooth losses; gives the first non-vacuous certified out-of-domain generalization on ImageNet and beats prior methods on smaller tasks.

title: Double Sampling Randomized Smoothing
summary: Double Sampling Randomized Smoothing (DSRS) tightens l2 certificates using probabilities from an additional smoothing distribution, provably certifying radius of order sqrt(d) under mild assumptions; certifies larger radii than baselines on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

title: GSmooth: Certified Robustness against Semantic Transformations via Generalized Randomized Smoothing
summary: GSmooth generalises randomized smoothing to certify robustness against general semantic transformations, including ones without closed forms such as defocus blur and pixelate, using dimension augmentation and a surrogate image-to-image network to approximate transformations.

title: Improved Certified Defenses against Data Poisoning with (Deterministic) Finite Aggregation
summary: Finite Aggregation certifies robustness against data poisoning by training base classifiers on overlapping unions of small disjoint subsets, improving on DPA; certified fractions rise by up to 3.05%, 3.87% and 4.77% on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and GTSRB.

title: Input-agnostic Certified Group Fairness via Gaussian Parameter Smoothing
summary: FairSmooth certifies group fairness of classifiers independent of input distribution using Gaussian parameter smoothing and averaged per-group smooth classifiers; nonlinear functional analysis shows the resulting manifold has an input-independent global Lipschitz constant.

title: Intriguing Properties of Input-Dependent Randomized Smoothing
summary: Shows input-dependent randomized smoothing methods lack formal guarantees and suffer from the curse of dimensionality, then gives a framework and concrete variance design that permits certified input-dependent smoothing under strict restrictions, tested on CIFAR10 and MNIST.

title: Linearity Grafting: Relaxed Neuron Pruning Helps Certifiable Robustness
summary: Linearity grafting linearises insignificant ReLU neurons and optimises their slopes and intercepts to tighten certified bounds, improving certifiable robustness by over 30% on CIFAR-10 without certified training and scaling complete verification to 17M-parameter models.

title: RetrievalGuard: Provably Robust 1-Nearest Neighbor Image Retrieval
summary: RetrievalGuard is a provably robust 1-nearest-neighbour image retrieval method that smooths the retrieval model to a bounded Lipschitz constant, keeping Recall@1 invariant to l2 adversarial perturbations within a computable radius.

title: Robustness Verification for Contrastive Learning
summary: RVCL is a robustness verification framework for contrastive learning encoders that avoids dependence on attacks, labels and downstream tasks, using extreme value theory to relate encoder robust radius to downstream radius; evaluates robustness of both models and images.

title: TPC: Transformation-Specific Smoothing for Point Cloud Models
summary: TPC certifies point cloud models against semantic transformations such as rotation, shearing and tapering with transformation-specific smoothing, covering additive, composable and indirectly composable categories; certified accuracy against z-axis twisting within 20 degrees rises from 20.3% to 83.8%.

title: ε-weakened robustness of deep neural networks
summary: Defines epsilon-weakened robustness, bounding the proportion of adversarial examples in a region, proves its decision problem PP-complete and gives statistical decision and maximum-radius algorithms with user-controlled error, polynomial in network dimension and size.

title: Example Guided Synthesis of Linear Approximations for Neural Network Verification
summary: Automatically synthesises sound linear approximations of activation functions for neural network verification by learning from generated examples, then bounding violations with global optimisation to restore soundness; solves more verification problems than hand-crafted approximations.

title: Neural Network Robustness as a Verification Property: A Principled Case Study
summary: Sets out general principles for empirically analysing neural network robustness as a mathematical property across training, verification and deployment, comparing the many existing robustness notions, and applies them in a case study showing practical benefits.

title: RINO: Robust INner and Outer Approximated Reachability of Neural Networks Controlled Systems
summary: RINO computes inner and outer approximations of reachable sets for discrete- and continuous-time systems controlled by neural networks, combining zonotopes with mean-value AE extensions and Taylor methods; it is at least an order of magnitude faster than Verisig 2.0 and ReachNN*.

title: Shared Certificates for Neural Network Verification
summary: Shared certificates reduce neural network verification cost by reusing intermediate-layer abstractions that overlap or contain each other across different inputs and perturbations, without precision loss; evaluated on image classifiers under patch and geometric perturbations.

title: Trainify: A CEGAR-Driven Training and Verification Framework for Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Trainify trains deep reinforcement learning systems on coarse abstract state spaces and refines them from counterexamples in a CEGAR loop until all properties verify; on six control systems it yields provably safe policies without sacrificing reward or robustness.

title: Verifying Neural Networks Against Backdoor Attacks
summary: Verifies that a neural network is free of backdoors at a given success rate by combining statistical sampling with abstract interpretation, either proving absence of a backdoor or generating trigger inputs, avoiding the accuracy loss of randomized smoothing.

title: Certified Robustness via Randomized Smoothing over Multiplicative Parameters of Input Transformations
summary: Randomized smoothing over multiplicative parameters of input transformations certifies classifiers against gamma correction perturbations; an asymmetric Rayleigh distribution gives better certificates than Gaussian, Laplace or uniform smoothing for some perturbation values.

title: Individual Fairness Guarantees for Neural Networks
summary: Certifies epsilon-delta individual fairness of feed-forward neural networks under learnt metrics such as Mahalanobis distance, globally bounding nonlinearities with piecewise-linear functions encoded as MILP; a modified loss yields networks orders of magnitude fairer than prior methods.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Verification of Deep Neural Networks
summary: Neuro-symbolic verification lets neural networks serve as part of logical specifications, extending verification to complex real-world properties such as stopping before a stop sign, and can be implemented on top of existing neural network verification infrastructure.

title: 3DeformRS: Certifying Spatial Deformations on Point Clouds
summary: 3DeformRS certifies point cloud DNNs against parameterised spatial deformations such as rotation and twisting by specialising randomized smoothing to vector-field deformations; for PointNet under 3-degree z-rotation it gives a 3x larger certificate 20x faster than prior work.

title: Certified Patch Robustness via Smoothed Vision Transformers
summary: Uses vision transformers within smoothing-based certified patch defenses, exploiting their ability to handle heavily masked images to obtain better certified patch robustness, faster inference and no substantial drop in standard accuracy.

title: Towards Practical Certifiable Patch Defense with Vision Transformer
summary: Certifies image classifiers against patch attacks by placing a Vision Transformer inside Derandomized Smoothing, trained with progressive smoothed image modeling and using isolated band unit self-attention; on ImageNet it reaches 41.70% certified accuracy under 2% patches, against 26.00% before.

title: Towards Practical Robustness Analysis for DNNs based on PAC-Model Learning
summary: DeepPAC analyses local robustness of DNNs in a black-box way, learning an affine model of local behaviour via scenario optimisation with a PAC guarantee; across 20 models on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and ImageNet it beats the statistical method PROVERO.

title: Formal Verification of Stochastic Systems with ReLU Neural Network Controllers
summary: Verifies safety of stochastic linear systems with Gaussian noise and ReLU network controllers by abstracting them as a graph, bounding transition probabilities with Satisfiability Modulo Convex formulas, and computing which initial states stay safe with given confidence over a horizon.

title: ROMAX: Certifiably Robust Deep Multiagent Reinforcement Learning via Convex Relaxation
summary: ROMAX trains multiagent reinforcement learning policies robust to worst-case updates of other agents, solving the inner minimisation of a minimax objective with convex relaxation of neural networks, which also gives a certified bound; it beats prior methods on mixed cooperative-competitive tasks.

title: Adversarially Robust Conformal Prediction
summary: Extends conformal prediction to adversarial inputs by smoothing the non-conformity score with Gaussian noise to bound its Lipschitz constant, giving prediction sets with finite-sample coverage under any l2-bounded attack; validated on CIFAR10, CIFAR100 and ImageNet.

title: Almost Tight L0-norm Certified Robustness of Top-k Predictions against Adversarial Perturbations
summary: Derives an almost tight l0-norm certified robustness guarantee for top-k predictions using randomized smoothing; on ImageNet the smoothed classifier reaches 69.2% certified top-3 accuracy when an attacker may change 5 pixels.

title: Boosting Randomized Smoothing with Variance Reduced Classifiers
summary: Uses ensembles as base models for randomized smoothing, since their lower variance under noise enlarges certified radii, and cuts sample complexity up to 55-fold; ensembles of 3 to 10 models reach average certified radius 0.86 on CIFAR10 and 1.11 on ImageNet.

title: Boosting the Certified Robustness of L-infinity Distance Nets
summary: Shows l-infinity-distance nets have an inherent certified robustness advantage and improves their training with a loss mixing scaled cross-entropy and clipped hinge loss, raising certified accuracy on CIFAR-10 at eps 8/255 from 33.30% to 40.06%.

title: Certified Robustness for Deep Equilibrium Models via Interval Bound Propagation
summary: IBP-MonDEQ is a deep equilibrium layer whose robustness is verified by interval bounds obtained as the unique fixed point of an IBP-inspired equilibrium equation; such models reach l-infinity certified robustness comparable to similar-sized explicit networks.

title: Complete Verification via Multi-Neuron Relaxation Guided Branch-and-Bound
summary: Builds a complete verifier that uses multi-neuron convex relaxations to sharply reduce the number of branch-and-bound subproblems and a GPU-based dual optimizer to solve the rest, achieving a new state of the art on established benchmarks and up to 28% certification gains on more accurate networks.

title: COPA: Certifying Robust Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning against Poisoning Attacks
summary: COPA certifies offline reinforcement learning policies against training-time poisoning, bounding how many manipulated trajectories are tolerated under per-state action stability and cumulative reward criteria, with new partition and aggregation protocols; some certificates are proved tight, others NP-complete.

title: CROP: Certifying Robust Policies for Reinforcement Learning through Functional Smoothing
summary: CROP certifies reinforcement learning policies at action and reward levels, using local smoothing of Q-function policies for per-state action robustness and global plus adaptive local smoothing for lower bounds on finite-horizon cumulative reward, evaluated on Atari, Highway and CartPole.

title: How to Robustify Black-Box ML Models? A Zeroth-Order Optimization Perspective
summary: ZO-AE-DS defends black-box models using only queries by combining denoised smoothing with zeroth-order optimization and a prepended autoencoder to reduce gradient-estimate variance, improving accuracy, certified robustness and query complexity on image classification and reconstruction.

title: Improved deterministic l2 robustness on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100
summary: Certifies 1-Lipschitz CNNs under l2 by relaxing orthogonalization of the last linear layer, adding a Householder activation and certificate regularization; provable robust accuracy rises 4.71% on CIFAR-100 and 5.81% on CIFAR-10.

title: On the Certified Robustness for Ensemble Models and Beyond
